name: Refactor Chat component
description:
# Chat Component Refactoring Summary

The Chat.vue component (560+ lines) is too large and handles multiple unrelated concerns. We identified **9 extractable pieces**: ChatCallBanner.vue (presentational), plus 8 composition controllers (useChatInputController, useChatFileController, useChatDropController, useChatIntelliSenseController, useChatAttachmentController, useChatVoiceController, useChatMessageController, useChatSubtaskController) that encapsulate specific domains like input editing, file operations, drag/drop, and voice management. This refactoring reduces Chat.vue to ~150 lines (73% smaller), improves testability and reusability, and maintains single responsibility per module with ~26 hours total implementation effort and manageable risk.

messages.content:
Chat component is too big, we must split in small pieces.
Analayze and suggest which parts can be extracted.

# Chat Component Analysis & Extraction Proposal ## Current State The Chat.vue component is **560+ lines** and handles: - Message rendering & management - File operations (upload, preview, sync) - Input handling (drag/drop, paste, voice) - IntelliSense/mentions autocomplete - Profile selection - PR view & threads - Call management - Multiple modal states --- ## Extraction Recommendations ### Priority 1: High-Impact, Low-Risk Extractions | Component | Current Lines | Responsibility | Extracted Size | Benefit | |-----------|--------------|-----------------|-----------------|---------| | **ChatInputController** | 150+ | Input state (edit mode, text, cursor) + keyboard shortcuts | ~120 lines | Single Responsibility: input logic isolated | | **ChatFileController** | 140+ | File operations (add, remove, preview, sync, export) | ~130 lines | Reusable file management | | **ChatDropController** | 100+ | Drag/drop, paste, file upload confirmation | ~95 lines | Encapsulates complex drop logic | | **ChatIntelliSenseController** | 80+ | Mention search, suggestions, keyboard navigation | ~75 lines | Mention/search logic decoupled | | **ChatCallBanner** | 25 | Active call display + end call button | ~20 lines | Presentational component | ### Priority 2: Medium-Impact Extractions | Component | Current Lines | Responsibility | Extracted Size | |-----------|--------------|-----------------|-----------------| | **ChatAttachmentController** | 60+ | Image attachment handling, validation | ~55 lines | | **ChatVoiceController** | 30+ | Voice session management | ~25 lines | | **ChatMessageController** | 70+ | Message editing, removal, toggling | ~65 lines | | **ChatSubtaskController** | 40+ | Subtask creation, threading | ~35 lines | ### Priority 3: Structural (Keeps Main Component Clean) | Component | Purpose | |-----------|---------| | **useChat()** | Computed properties (activeMessages, lastMessage, etc.) | | **useChatState()** | Reactive state management (editing, waiting, dragging) | | **useChatUtils()** | Helper methods (normalizePath, hasFile, etc.) | --- ## Proposed Architecture ``` Chat.vue (Main Orchestrator - ~150 lines) ├── ChatCallBanner.vue (New - 20 lines) ├── Composition Helpers │ ├── useChatInputController.js (120 lines) │ ├── useChatFileController.js (130 lines) │ ├── useChatDropController.js (95 lines) │ ├── useChatIntelliSenseController.js (75 lines) │ ├── useChatAttachmentController.js (55 lines) │ ├── useChatVoiceController.js (25 lines) │ ├── useChatMessageController.js (65 lines) │ ├── useChatSubtaskController.js (35 lines) │ └── useChatState.js (50 lines) └── [Existing child components] ``` --- ## Detailed Extraction Breakdown ### 1. **useChatInputController.js** (120 lines) **Responsibility:** Text editing, cursor position, keyboard shortcuts **Methods to extract:** - `setEditorText(text)` - `onMessageChange()` - `updateCursorWord()` - `onEditMessage(message)` + `onResetEdit()` - `updateMessage()` - `onEditMessageKeyDown(event)` - `hideAll()` - `createBlock()` - `replaceEmoji()` **Data to extract:** - `editMessage`, `editMessageId` - `cursorWord`, `editorText` - `previousEditorText` - `textProfileNames`, `selectorProfileNames` ```js useChatInputController.js export function useChatInputController(component) { return { editMessage: null, editMessageId: null, cursorWord: {}, editorText: '', previousEditorText: '', textProfileNames: [], selectorProfileNames: [], setEditorText(text) { component.$refs.inputBox?.setEditorText(text) }, onMessageChange() { const text = component.$refs.inputBox?.getEditorText() ?? '' if (text !== this.editorText) this.editorText = text }, updateCursorWord() { this.cursorWord = component.$refs.inputBox?.getCaretWordInfo() ?? {} }, onEditMessage(message) { // ... existing logic }, onResetEdit() { // ... existing logic }, // ... all other edit-related methods } } ``` --- ### 2. **useChatFileController.js** (130 lines) **Responsibility:** File operations (add, remove, preview, sync, export) **Methods to extract:** - `onAddFile(file)` - `onAddFileToChat(file)` - `removeFileFromChat(file)` - `removeFileFromMessage()` - `removeFileFromFiles(file)` - `openFilePreview(filePath)` - `closeFilePreview()` - `onPreviewFileSaved()` - `handleFilePreview(filePath)` - `syncNotebook(file)` - `exportNotebook(file)` - `addFileToMessage(file)` - `hasFile()`, `hasFileInChat()`, `hasFileInMessage()` - `normalizeFilePath(path)` - `showNotebookStatus(msg)` **Data to extract:** - `previewFile`, `notebookStatus` ```js useChatFileController.js export function useChatFileController(component, chatService) { return { previewFile: null, notebookStatus: null, onAddFile(file) { if (!this.hasFileInChat(file) && chatService.addFileToChat({ chat: component.chat, file })) {} }, hasFileInChat(file) { return this.hasFile(file, component.chatFiles) }, normalizeFilePath(path) { return path?.toLowerCase().trim() || '' }, // ... all file methods } } ``` --- ### 3. **useChatDropController.js** (95 lines) **Responsibility:** Drag/drop, paste, upload confirmation **Methods to extract:** - `onDragOver()` - `handleDragLeave(e)` - `onDropChat(e)` - `onDropInputBox(e)` - `onDrop(e, chatDrop)` - `processDropUrls(dataTransfer, chatDrop)` - `processMultipleFilePaths(textContent, chatDrop)` - `processJsonFileList(jsonData, chatDrop)` - `processFilePath(filePath, chatDrop)` - `onContentPaste(e)` - `processInputTextContent(textContent, chatDrop)` - `uploadLocalFiles(fileList, chatDrop)` - `showUploadConfirmation()` - `confirmUpload()`, `cancelUpload()` - `performUpload(fileList, uploadPath)` **Data to extract:** - `draggingOver`, `dragCounter`, `dragoverTimeout` - `pasteWithShift`, `showUploadConfirmModal` - `pendingUploadFiles`, `uploadPath`, `uploadContext` --- ### 4. **useChatIntelliSenseController.js** (75 lines) **Responsibility:** Mention/file autocomplete logic **Methods to extract:** - `scheduleIntelliSense(word)` - `runIntelliSense(word)` - `cancelIntelliSense()` - `onIntelliSenseSelect(suggestion)` - `onIntelliSenseAcceptMulti(items)` - `dismissIntelliSense()` - `onChatInputKeyDown(event)` - `updateProfileMentionsFromText()` **Data to extract:** - `intelliSenseSuggestions`, `intelliSenseIndex` - `intelliSenseQuery`, `intelliSenseProgress` - `intelliSenseDebounce`, `intelliSenseDismissed` - `searchController`, `previousQuery` --- ### 5. **useChatAttachmentController.js** (55 lines) **Responsibility:** Image attachment handling **Methods to extract:** - `validateImageSize(file)` - `fileToBase64(file)` - `prepareAttachmentFromFile(file)` - `prepareAttachmentFromUrl(imgUrl)` - `extractFileNameFromUrl(url)` - `processMultipleImages(imageFiles, isMessage)` - `removeAttachment(idx)` - `removeAttachmentByIndex(idx)` **Data to extract:** - `attachments`, `MAX_IMAGE_SIZE_MB` --- ### 6. **useChatMessageController.js** (65 lines) **Responsibility:** Message editing/removal/state **Methods to extract:** - `toggleHide({ doc_id, hide })` - `toggleAnswer({ doc_id, is_answer })` - `removeMessage(message)` - `onMessageChange({ doc_id, content })` - `onMessageEdited({ doc_id, content, profiles, llm_model })` - `onCopy(message)` - `onReloadMessageFile({ file, message })` - `onSaveFile({ file, content })` - `onOpenFile(file)` - `runEdit(codeSnippet)` - `onGenerateCode({ codeSnippet, language })` --- ### 7. **useChatVoiceController.js** (25 lines) **Responsibility:** Voice session & recognition **Methods to extract:** - `toggleVoiceSession()` - `stopVoiceSession()` **Data to extract:** - `isVoiceSession`, `recognition` --- ### 8. **useChatSubtaskController.js** (35 lines) **Responsibility:** Subtask & thread creation **Methods to extract:** - `createChatSubTask({ title, files, description, ... })` - `onChatEntryCreateSubtask({ file, content, title })` - `onNewThread(message)` - `onPRFileComment({ file, lineNumber, comment, diff })` - `addFileContentAsMessage(file)` --- ### 9. **ChatCallBanner.vue** (20 lines) **New Presentational Component** ```vue ChatCallBanner.vue ``` --- ## Refactored Chat.vue (150 lines) ```vue src/components/chat/Chat.vue ``` --- ## Implementation Timeline | Phase | Components | Effort | Risk | |-------|-----------|--------|------| | **1** | ChatCallBanner.vue | 2 hrs | ⭕ None | | **2** | useChatInputController.js | 4 hrs | 🟡 Medium | | **3** | useChatFileController.js | 5 hrs | 🟡 Medium | | **4** | useChatDropController.js | 4 hrs | 🟡 Medium | | **5** | useChatIntelliSenseController.js | 3 hrs | ⭕ None | | **6** | useChatAttachmentController.js | 2 hrs | ⭕ None | | **7** | useChatVoiceController.js | 1 hr | ⭕ None | | **8** | useChatMessageController.js | 3 hrs | 🟡 Medium | | **9** | useChatSubtaskController.js | 2 hrs | ⭕ None | | **Total** | | ~26 hrs | Manageable | --- ## Benefits After Extraction ✅ **Chat.vue reduces from 560 lines → ~150 lines** (73% reduction) ✅ **Each controller handles single domain** (Input, Files, Drop, Voice, etc.) ✅ **Easier testing** - controllers can be unit tested in isolation ✅ **Better reusability** - controllers can be used in other components ✅ **Clearer data flow** - related state grouped together ✅ **Maintainability** - changes to file logic don't affect input logic Ready to implement? I can generate full files for any controller.
